_comment: Manually fetched, one at a time, by a human action — not by a crawler. NCBI Bookshelf's own copyright page prohibits automated/systematic retrieval, so the ingest code (backend/app/knowledge/ingest/nci_pdq.py) only ever parses these local files; it makes no HTTP requests. Adding more summaries means repeating this manual capture step deliberately and appending an entry here.
